stories.headline: A barber found $128,514 on top of an ATM and returned it all
stories.summary: A bag stuffed with cash and 19 checks sat on a bank's ATM, apparently left by a repair technician. The man called police at once and handed it over. Police counted every dollar.
stories.why: A detective said nobody had ever turned in that much money before.

stories.headline: A 46,000-year-old Neanderthal hand was found in a Spanish cave
stories.summary: 6 bone fragments from Abauntz cave belong to a Neanderthal man's right hand, the first Neanderthal remains ever found in Navarre. His DNA survived well enough to study.
stories.why: He lived near the very end of the Neanderthals, about 6,000 years before they vanished.

stories.headline: A rare egg from an extinct giant bird is going home to New Zealand
stories.summary: Found in 1966, the moa egg spent about 60 years in a US private collection. Colossal Biosciences bought it at auction to return it to Ngāi Tahu, the Māori people whose ancestors lived with moa.
stories.why: Restored, it may become only the 9th nearly intact moa egg known.

stories.stat_label: months old when she was rescued
stories.headline: A gorilla rescued from traffickers is now a mother in the wild
stories.summary: Lulingu, a critically endangered Grauer's gorilla, was saved from traffickers as a baby and raised at the GRACE sanctuary. Released near Mt. Tshiaberimu, she has given birth and is raising her baby.
stories.why: Her success has her carers planning to return more rescued gorillas to the wild.

fun_fact: The tallest moa could stand nearly 12 feet (3.6 m) tall with its neck stretched up.
